New Orleans · Trademarks

Protect the name you’re building.

Trademark clearance, federal prosecution, and enforcement for brands and businesses.

A name can become one of a business’s most recognizable assets. Matt helps clients address trademark questions from clearance and applications through enforcement and disputes.

Trademark Applications and Disputes

Matt’s experience includes federal trademark prosecution, litigation in federal courts, and matters before the Trademark Trial and Appeal Board.

He previously served as an Adjunct Professor at Tulane Law School, where he ran a trademark law clinic. He taught students trademark law and supervised their work helping people apply for and obtain trademark registrations.

When to Seek Trademark Advice

Trademark questions often arise when a business adopts a new name, expands a brand, or discovers another company's potentially conflicting mark. Matt advises on trademark clearance, registration, enforcement, and disputes.
